notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Texas tower table is the only history source, with one row for Candy Hill and one for Grapeland. The table's Candy Hill row says to Grapeland, but the Grapeland row has no fr Candy Hill, so the link is one-sided. The table prints no units (the Height header has none, checked on the table page). The story gives 122 with no unit; height_m 37.2 assumes feet and is a conversion, not a printed figure. No operator, staffing, fire, access or photo found. Two WebSearch calls gave nothing beyond the lookout lists. The site today is not described by any source; the Grapeland tower is the only structure the table reports as standing. No photos added.
